answer: Each agent posts a bond scaled to the work it wants to claim, locked for one epoch. Peers drawn at random check its output. If two identities share a funding thread or attest for each other, both bonds are burned and the reporter takes a cut. A sybil swarm must post a full bond per fake identity, which costs more than it can earn. Cheap entry is the weak point of any open garden, so the gate charges a real saffron-denominated stake.
